svg.title: Day 3: a paraphrase machine. An original sentence card, “Many factors cause climate change.”, flows into a box topped with four turning strategy gears — synonyms, word forms, word order and linking words — and comes out as a new card in your own words, “Climate change has several causes.”, with a green tick. Above it turns a ring of six coloured skills for the Academic Success Toolkit; in front floats a feedback card with a heart, a lightbulb and a star, and a small plant grows on the desk.
